title: Module 3 Quiz: Setting Up Your First Wallet

questions.text: Which type of wallet is considered the most secure according to the lessons?
options: A wallet app left logged in on a shared phone
questions.explanation: Cold wallets are hardware devices that keep keys completely offline, making them the most secure storage method.

questions.text: Where should you keep a second handwritten copy of your seed phrase?
options: In the same notebook as the first copy
On a screenshot stored in your phone
Saved in a cloud notes app
questions.explanation: Keep a second handwritten copy in a completely separate secure location, so one damaged or lost copy does not lock you out.

questions.text: What will a legitimate wallet support agent never ask you for?
options: Your seed phrase or private keys
questions.explanation: No legitimate support will ever request your seed phrase or private keys.

questions.text: True or false: Using an authenticator app for two-factor authentication is preferred over plain SMS.
questions.explanation: True. Use time-based two-factor authentication from an authenticator app rather than plain SMS text messages.
